english.title: Failing to notify water undertaker of instalation of water fitting
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having proposed to install a water fitting in connection with an operation listed in the Table attached to regulation 5 of the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, namely **(..SPECIFY OPERATION..), failed to give notice to the water undertaker that you proposed to begin work
